svg.text: Ireland county clickers — geographic preview only
208 x 271 mm · Tyrone ~62 mm handheld · standalone pieces · independently enlarged where needed · not tessellating

Near-white GAA shells show their top colour on this preview so the county stays visible · boosted for switch: Armagh, Carlow, Cavan, Derry, Down, Dublin, Fermanagh, Kildare, Kilkenny, Laois, Leitrim, Limerick, Longford, Louth, Meath, Monaghan, Offaly, Roscommon, Sligo, Waterford, Westmeath, Wexford
